tasks.title: Write an Email
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You and your friend, Taylor, are considering joining a student club this semester. You recently found out about a club that interests you and want to recommend it to Taylor. Write an email to Taylor.
bullets: Describe the club and what club members do.
Explain why the club is a good fit for you and for Taylor.
Inform Taylor where he can find more information about the club.
tasks.subject: Club recommendation
